**STEP 7 - Energy:** Scrambled egg (cooked, with little added fat visible) ≈ 150 kcal/100 g, so 146 g ≈ 219 kcal. Herb ≈ 36 kcal/100 g, so ~1 g ≈ 0.4 kcal.
